function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

**Shashi Tej Reddy** is a former Indian Army officer who later entered politics in the southern Indian state of Telangana.  
He joined the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) and was elected to the Telangana Legislative Assembly. During his tenure he served as a cabinet minister in the state government, holding portfolios such as Food & Civil Supplies and later as Minister for Rural Development and Panchayati Raj.  

Reddy’s political career has been marked by both achievements and controversies. He was a prominent figure during the 2018 Telangana elections, where he played a key role in campaigning for the TRS. However, he has also faced allegations of corruption and misuse of office, leading to investigations and legal proceedings.  

In addition to his legislative work, Reddy has been involved in various development projects aimed at improving rural infrastructure and food distribution systems in Telangana.
